call_points.text: ₹25 Cr capex available for merchant equipment from IPO proceeds
Target ₹1,000 Cr quarterly lending disbursements from Q2FY27
Net payments margin guided at 12-14 bps long-term
Regulatory delays in PPI on UPI monetization continue
Offline merchant payment business targets a 5x device scale-up to enable 10x revenue growth by FY28.
Online merchant acquiring business Zaakpay targets 10x GMV by FY28.
Merchant payments investment was ₹55 Cr in FY26 and is expected in a similar range in FY27.
LSP business to move to a wholly owned subsidiary in two to three months; NBFC setup in three to six months, launch in six to nine.
call_points.versus_prior: follows the RBI NBFC licence approval in April 2026

call_points.text: Q4 finance cost fell to ₹5.1 Cr from ₹7.2 Cr in Q3.
Only remaining debt is ₹261 Cr of short-term working capital lines as of 31 March.
Net owned unencumbered cash is about ₹434 Cr, though part is still locked in IPO proceeds.
Super-prime share of disbursements rose from 10% to 32% and repeat loans from 20% to 63.5%.
Management declined to give the targeted NBFC versus LSP lending split, saying it is too soon.

guidance.statement: GMV growth of 30-35% expected in FY27 in both payments and lending.
Reported EBITDA margin expected in the same broad 5% range in FY27.
Digital credit GMV growth of 30-35% expected in FY27.
Payments take rate guided at 12-15 bps over the mid to long term.
Lending margin seen at 4.5% as more sustainable long term.
Targets 10x growth in merchant payment business by FY28 following PA-P in-principle licence approval.

operating_notes.text: MobiKwik secured RBI approval for its NBFC license application in under four months.
Payments GMV hit an all-time high of INR 524 billion in Q4FY26, up 58% YoY and 9% QoQ, the 13th consecutive quarter of record GMV.
Super-prime share of disbursements rose from 10% to 32% and repeat loans from 20% to 63.5% year-over-year.
Merchant payments investment was INR 55 crores in FY26 and expected in a similar range in FY27.
LSP business revenue was INR 2,613.75 million (22.70% of standalone revenue) and net worth INR 952.21 million (16.94% of standalone net worth) in FY2025-26.
MobiKwik has 4.9 million registered merchants and 189 million registered users as of May 2026.
MobiKwik holds a 20% market share in PPI wallet Gross Transaction Value (GTV) as of March 2026.
60% of loans went to repeat customers
₹900-1000 Cr accumulated tax losses available for offset

timeline.summary: On April 27, 2026, One MobiKwik Systems announced that the RBI approved its application for an NBFC license to expand regulated lending capabilities.
On May 4, 2026, One MobiKwik Systems launched its #EverythingIsFair marketing campaign featuring Rajasthan Royals cricketers to promote UPI cashback and instant personal loans.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹288.71 Cr (+7.8% YoY), net profit ₹4.38 Cr (against a loss of ₹56.04 Cr a year earlier).
On May 12, 2026, One MobiKwik Systems reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹296 Cr and a net profit of ₹4.4 Cr, marking its second consecutive profitable quarter.
One MobiKwik Systems filed its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 showing ₹187.61 crore of unutilised IPO proceeds.
ANKITA Sharma, CFO, shared the earnings call recording for analysts and investors on May 12, 2026, via the company’s IR website.
On May 12, 2026, One MobiKwik Systems reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹296 Cr and a net profit of ₹4.4 Cr.
One Mobikwik Systems approved the slump sale of its LSP business to its wholly-owned subsidiary MDSPL to comply with RBI NBFC licensing requirements.
MobiKwik received RBI in-principle approval for a Physical Payment Aggregator (PA-P) licence to scale its merchant payments business.
MobiKwik Q1FY27 results: third consecutive profitable quarter with PAT ₹7.6 Cr, GMV up 50% YoY to ₹58,700 Cr
